title: Tendercare student transcript data
description: One JSON file per student. The generator script renders this + the shared template into that student's static, hardcoded HTML report page -- no database read happens at page-view time.

entry_year.description: Academic year the student's record starts, e.g. '2025/2026'. Combined with class_arm's seniority, this determines how many year-sections the template renders (a JSS1 student gets 1 year block, an SS3 student gets up to 6).

access_code_hint.description: Not a secret -- matches the interim shared-password gate already in the report sheets. Kept here only so the generator can render the gate-note text; the actual check is client-side plaintext comparison, same as the existing files.

years.description: One entry per academic year this student has been enrolled, oldest first. A senior student (e.g. SS3) should have as many entries as years of seniority; a junior student (JSS1) has one.

terms.description: Always exactly 3 entries (First/Second/Third) -- a term with no data yet is digitized: false, which the template renders as the existing 'Record not yet digitized' placeholder panel, not an empty or missing term.

subjects.description: Required only when digitized is true.
